title: OMES AgentDeployment manifest v1
description: Versioned schema for the native OMES + Hermes + systemd agent deployment manifest (issue #87). Field names mirror the illustrative manifest in docs/agent-orchestration-roadmap.md section 4. Validated by lib/omes/py/agent/manifest.py's stdlib validator, not scripts/check-contracts.py (that script belongs to a different contract area).

name.description: Stable logical agent name. Also used to derive the systemd unit name (omes-agent-<name>.service) and the HERMES_HOME isolation path, so it is restricted to a safe, unambiguous character set.

runtime.description: MVP supports only 'hermes' (issue #87 acceptance criterion); any other value must fail preflight before mutation.

profile.description: Hermes profile name; used to derive the agent's isolated HERMES_HOME, never a shared one.

backend.description: 'systemd' is the MVP backend (issue #87). 'compose' is the rootless Docker Compose isolation backend (issue #96, docs/agent-orchestration-roadmap.md section 2.2); when set, 'spec.compose' is required (enforced in lib/omes/py/agent/manifest.py, since this stdlib schema engine has no conditional-required keyword).

cpu.description: CPU quota expressed as core-count, rendered into systemd CPUQuota= (e.g. '1.0' -> '100%').

secrets.description: Secret REFERENCES only (env var / secret-store key names). Never a value.

compose.description: Required when spec.backend is 'compose' (issue #96). Rootless Docker Compose isolation for one agent deployment. Never grants Docker socket access to the agent container; see lib/omes/py/agent/compose.py for the full validation this schema alone cannot express (digest-only images, host-path containment under the agent's own state dir, no privileged/host-PID/host-network, localhost-only port binds).

topology.description: Container topology ('shared' or 'dedicated'). Defaults to 'dedicated' for v1 backward compatibility.

image.description: Must be pinned by digest (@sha256:<64 hex>). A tag-only reference (e.g. ':latest') is rejected.

project.description: Compose project name (-p). Defaults to 'omes-agent-<name>' when omitted.

network.description: Isolated per-agent Docker network name. Defaults to 'omes-agent-<name>-net'. The literal value 'host' is rejected in lib/omes/py/agent/compose.py even though it would match this pattern.

user.description: Non-root 'uid:gid' the container runs as. uid 0 and gid 0 are both rejected.

capDrop.description: Defaults to ['ALL'] when omitted. lib/omes/py/agent/compose.py rejects any value other than exactly ['ALL'] - this backend never re-adds capabilities.

hostPath.description: Must resolve under this agent's own OMES-managed state directory; must not contain ':' (blocks smuggling extra bind-mount flags such as ':Z') and must not reference /var/run/docker.sock.

ports.description: Empty by default. Only loopback binds are allowed.
